goal: Replace the plugin-inside-a-plugin loader with explicit isolated registration of the few retained primitive behaviors.
plan: Inventory behavior, explicitly import retained primitives, simplify bounded prompt injection and whimsical feedback, then remove dynamic loading.

tasks.title: Inventory retained primitive outcomes
acceptance: Useful primitive outcomes and their current tests are documented
Dynamic-loading, prompt-injection, and whimsical runtime behaviors are characterized

approachReasons.diagnosis: Retained outcomes must be separated from loader mechanics before implementation.

tasks.title: Implement explicit primitive registration
acceptance: Retained primitives are explicitly imported and registered
One primitive failure does not obscure startup diagnostics

approachReasons.tdd: Registration and isolated-failure behavior need deterministic tests.
approachReasons.operations: Startup diagnostics must remain actionable when one primitive fails.

tasks.title: Simplify conditional prompt injection
acceptance: Prompt injection remains conditional and bounded
Injection does not require dynamic loading

approachReasons.tdd: Conditions and bounds are explicit testable contracts.
approachReasons.security: Prompt content and activation boundaries must avoid unintended disclosure or influence.
approachReasons.performance: Bounded injection limits startup and context overhead.

tasks.title: Replace or remove whimsical runtime machinery
acceptance: Whimsical messages use a small data resource or native working indicator

approachReasons.migration: Existing machinery must be replaced or removed without duplicate behavior.
approachReasons.performance: A small static resource or native indicator avoids runtime overhead.

tasks.title: Remove dynamic loading and qualify startup
acceptance: No directory scanning or cache-busting dynamic imports remain
Primitive tests, typecheck, and package checks pass
Startup diagnostics identify isolated primitive failures

approachReasons.tdd: Final retained behavior and removal constraints need regression coverage.
approachReasons.performance: Startup must be qualified after eliminating scans and dynamic imports.
approachReasons.operations: Diagnostic clarity is a startup reliability requirement.
